item.title: Oakland’s famous tostada is back. Cenaduria Elvira is opening near Jack London Square
item.description: Oakland’s famous tostada is back. Cenaduria Elvira is opening near Jack London Square Her regional Mexican fare attracted national accolades and international visitors to her backyard patio. Now, Elvira Varela is ready to open her first brick-and-mortar restaurant.

item.title: 9 Oakland ‘Ghost Town’ gang members sentenced for 2022 robbery spree
item.description: 9 Oakland ‘Ghost Town’ gang members sentenced for 2022 robbery spree Federal prosecutors say they took down one of the networks “responsible for the majority of group-driven violence” in Oakland. Defense attorneys point to traumatic childhoods and PTSD as drivers of crime.

item.title: Oakland schools brace for staff layoffs
item.description: Oakland schools brace for staff layoffs Workers who support student attendance, community schools, and literacy could be defunded next year.

item.title: BART releases doomsday scenario in case sales tax doesn’t pass
item.description: BART releases doomsday scenario in case sales tax doesn’t pass A proposal to raise $1 billion a year will likely be on the November ballot. But BART is planning for massive service cuts — including a total system shutdown — if the measure is voted down.

item.title: This week in Oakland: the Trash Falcons exhibit ‘What We Sow,’ and the making of the Black Joy Parade at OMCA
item.description: This week in Oakland: the Trash Falcons exhibit ‘What We Sow,’ and the making of the Black Joy Parade at OMCA Other events include two Valentine’s Day mixers, and the screening of the Oscar-nominated documentary “The Alabama Solution.”

item.title: Flock license plate scanner contract postponed by Alameda County leaders
item.description: Flock license plate scanner contract postponed by Alameda County leaders The Board of Supervisors has questions for the sheriff about the controversial surveillance company.

item.title: As Kneaded expands with cafe, plus new Mediterranean, Thai and donut options hit the East Bay
item.description: As Kneaded expands with cafe, plus new Mediterranean, Thai and donut options hit the East Bay A running list of restaurants that have recently opened in Berkeley, Oakland, Richmond, and beyond.

item.title: Former San Leandro councilmember pleads guilty in corruption case tied to Oakland
item.description: Former San Leandro councilmember pleads guilty in corruption case tied to Oakland Bryan Azevedo pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit fraud and lying to a federal agency on Wednesday. Court officials confirmed he is cooperating with the government’s probe of East Bay corruption.

item.title: Oakland police say they’re investigating overtime issues revealed by Oaklandside
item.description: Oakland police say they’re investigating overtime issues revealed by Oaklandside The police officers' union adamantly defended a lieutenant's use of overtime, saying he’s been unfairly singled out.

item.title: A turf war over parking enforcement bursts into public view
item.description: A turf war over parking enforcement bursts into public view The finance department has faced stiff resistance to its plan to take over parking enforcement — and have OPD recover abandoned vehicles. Officials presented their plan at a city council committee meeting on Tuesday.
